{{Quote|Hail, O Queen of the Red. We live to serve, and die to serve.|The Chosen pledges his life to the Queen of the Red|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
A [[Storm-hair]] was a '''Chosen''', one of Storm-hair [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] who emerged from an [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva)|unidentified planet]] with him. The Chosen, who was one of Esva's most loyal servants, had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and multifaceted bright yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> Esva's warrior stayed in front of the [[Dwelling of Guests]] building within the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

When the Quesoth species' ruler and Esva's ally, the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]], approached the dwelling's entrance, the Storm-hair pledged their life to her as mandated by Quesoth custom, which Trevik considered fortunate. The warrior and the [[Queen of the Red|Queen's]] entourage then entered the building, where the Storm-hair warlord spoke with the [[Queen/Legends|monarch]]. The following [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Esva and the Chosen were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] between Storm-hair and [[Quesoth Soldier|Quesoth forces]] and the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Storm-hair appeared in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
